messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

I understand the confusion. Even though you have excellent signal and data enabled, the speed test shows no connection. This could be because data roaming might not be enabled on your phone itself (in addition to the line having roaming enabled, which I already did for you).

Let me check your current network status to see the full picture. Please use the following action on your phone:

**check_network_status**

This will show me the current status including whether data roaming is enabled on your device. After you do this, let me know what it shows.

The network status shows that Airplane Mode is off, cellular connection is connected with excellent 5G signal, mobile data is enabled, but data roaming is not enabled. Wi-Fi is off. What do you want me to do next?

Please explain the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
